Storage names (SNDK, WDC, STX) leading alongside AI infra (DELL, ANET, SMCI) — classic memory + datacenter buildout theme rotating with semis.

sector_breadth_notes.note: All three qualifying industries are inside Technology — semis, semi equipment, and hardware all firing together. Move is genuine and stacked, not narrow.
Sector qualifying at ETF level but no industry passed 6.5 gate; Steel scoring 2.62 — move is shallow and not led by any cohesive industry.
Three insurance sub-industries (Life, Brokers, Specialty) all at the bottom of the laggard list — financials strength is NOT coming from insurance.
Travel Services and Lodging deeply red despite XLY qualifying — consumer discretionary strength is not travel/leisure driven.
Grocery Stores and Education laggards — staples qualifying ETF is being lifted by non-grocery defensive pockets.
Trucking in laggards — no industrial industry crossed gate, meaning XLI strength is diffuse with no clear sub-theme.

key_divergences: Major divergence: 9 sector ETFs qualified but only Technology produced any industry above the 6.5 gate. Insurance dragging XLF, Travel/Lodging dragging XLY, Steel dragging XLB — broad sector strength is largely a tech-led tape with thin participation elsewhere.
leadership_theme: Semiconductor complex leading: equipment, chips, and AI hardware all firing in unison
